log_facility.description: Specify the log facility to use (e.g., daemon, local0).

log_priority.description: Specify the log priority to use (e.g., info, warning, error).

poll_interval.description: Specify the poll interval to check the SEL for new events (in seconds).

hostname.description: Specify the remote host(s) to communicate with. Multiple hostnames may be separated by comma or in range format.

driver-type.description: Specify the driver type to use (e.g., linux). Optional.

driver-address.description: Specify the in-band driver address to use. Optional.

driver-device.description: Specify the in-band driver device path to use. Optional.

register-spacing.description: Specify the in-band driver register spacing to use. Optional.

target-channel-number.description: Specify the in-band driver target channel number. Optional.

target-slave-address.description: Specify the in-band driver target slave address. Optional.

disable-auto-probe.description: Specify if IPMI devices should be probed for settings (ENABLE|DISABLE). Optional.

session-timeout.description: Specify the session timeout length to use in milliseconds. Optional.

retransmission-timeout.description: Specify the retransmission timeout length to use in milliseconds. Optional.

authentication-type.description: Specify the authentication type to use (NONE, STRAIGHT_PASSWORD_KEY, MD2, MD5). Optional.

cipher-suite-id.description: Specify the cipher suite id to use. Optional.

privilege-level.description: Specify the privilege type to use (USER, OPERATOR, ADMIN). Optional.

workaround-flags.description: Specify workaround flags to use. Optional.

k_g.description: Specify the BMC key (K_g) to use. Prefix with '0x' for hex. Optional.

verbose-count.description: Specify default verbose count to use for ipmi-sel(8). Optional.

sensors-types.description: Specify sensor types of SEL events to log. Optional.

exclude-sensor-types.description: Specify sensor types of SEL events to not log. Optional.

system-event-only.description: Specify if output should only include system event records (ENABLE|DISABLE). Optional.

oem-event-only.description: Specify if output should only include OEM event records (ENABLE|DISABLE). Optional.

event-state-config-file.description: Specify the event state configuration file. Optional.

interpret-oem-data.description: Specify if ipmiseld should attempt to interpret OEM data or not (ENABLE|DISABLE). Optional.

entity-sensor-names.description: Specify if output of sensor names should include entity ids and instances or not (ENABLE|DISABLE). Optional.

non-abbreviated-units.description: Specify if output should have units abbreviated by default or not (ENABLE|DISABLE). Optional.

event-state-filter.description: Specify event states to be filtered out and not logged. Optional.

warning-threshold.description: Specify SEL fullness warning threshold as an integer percentage. Optional.

clear-threshold.description: Specify SEL fullness clear threshold as an integer percentage. Optional.

system-event-format.description: Specify the format of the log output when a SEL system event is encountered. Optional.

oem-timestamped-event-format.description: Specify the format of the log output when a SEL OEM timestamped event is encountered. Optional.

oem-non-timestamped-event-format.description: Specify the format of the log output when a SEL OEM non-timestamped event is encountered. Optional.

cache-directory.description: Specify the cache directory to use. Optional.

ignore-sdr.description: Specify if the SDR should be ignored (DISABLE|ENABLE - note: man page says 'DISABLE' is the value for 'ignore-sdr' directive? re-download-sdr.description: Specify if the SDR should be re-downloaded on start (ENABLE|DISABLE). Optional.

clear-sel.description: Specify if the SEL should be cleared on start (ENABLE|DISABLE). Optional.

threadpool-count.description: Specify the threadpool count for parallel SEL polling. Optional.
